While the book is on your person, you have those spells prepared, and they count as Warlock spells for you; the book can serve as a Spellcasting Focus. The book disappears if you die or conjure a new one.
В ладони появляется холодное пламя: ярки: A flickering flame appears in your hand, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Until it goes out, you can take a Magic action to hurl it at a target within 60 feet—a ranged spell attack dealing **1d8** Fire damage. Casting the spell again ends the previous casting.
В любом ранее виденном вами месте в пред: An intangible illusory copy of you appears at a location within range that you have seen before; if it takes any damage, it disappears, and the spell ends. You can see and hear through it; as a **Magic action**, you move it up to 60 feet and make it speak and gesture. Objects pass through the copy; a creature can discern it with the Study action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
В начале своего хода вы можете потратить:
At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes (or until you have the Incapacitated condition):

- **Reach.** The reach of your Unarmed Strikes increases by 10 feet.
- **Elemental Strikes.** When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you can cause it to deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. When you deal such damage, you can also force the target to make a Strength saving throw: on a failed save, it is moved up to 10 feet toward or away from you.
At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute (or until you have the Incapacitated condition), you have Resistance to all damage except Force damage.
В незанятом пространстве на земле в пред: A motionless, claw-footed cauldron appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet, filled with liquid that has the properties of a **Common or Uncommon potion** of your choice. As a Bonus Action, you or an ally can reach into the cauldron and withdraw a vial of that potion (the vial vanishes once the potion is drunk). The number of potions that can be withdrawn equals your **spellcasting ability modifier** (minimum 1); after the last one, the cauldron disappears and the spell ends. Undrunk potions disappear when you cast the spell again.
В незанятом пространстве появляется Боль: A Large **pack** of spectral animals (wolves, serpents, birds…) appears in an unoccupied space. While you are within 5 feet of it, you have Advantage on Strength saving throws; when you move on your turn, you can also move the pack up to 30 feet. Whenever the pack moves within 10 feet of a creature you can see, or a creature enters a space within 10 feet of the pack or ends its turn there, you can force a Dexterity saving throw (once per turn): on a failed save, 3d10 Slashing damage.
В первом раунде каждого боя вы совершает: In the first round of each combat, you take two turns: the first at your normal Initiative and the second at your Initiative minus 10.
В пределах дистанции появляется мерцающа: A shimmering **5-by-10-foot** door appears within range, leading to an extradimensional dwelling; you and the creatures you designate when you cast the spell can enter. While within 30 feet of the door, you can open or close it without an action; when closed, the door is imperceptible. Inside are up to **50 contiguous 10-foot Cubes** with any floor plan and furnishings you like, fresh and warm air, food for 100 people, and **100 invulnerable servants** that do any work a human servant could but can't harm anyone or leave the mansion. Objects taken out of the mansion turn to smoke; when the spell ends, everything and everyone inside ends up near the entrance.
В пределах дистанции появляется парящая: A floating spectral force resembling a weapon of your choice appears within range. You immediately make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: on a hit, Force damage equal to **1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier**. On later turns, as a Bonus Action, you can move it up to 20 feet and repeat the attack.
В проверках Интеллекта и Мудрости и спас: When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check or a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10. Starting at level 10, you also gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover.
В проверке характеристики с навыком или: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
В руке появляются 10 волшебных ягод. Сущ: Ten magic berries appear in your hand. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry: it restores **1 Hit Point** and provides enough nourishment for one day. Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.
В свободной руке появляется огненный кли: A fiery blade the size of a scimitar appears in your free hand; if you let go of it, it vanishes, but you can call it back as a Bonus Action. As a Magic action you make a melee spell attack with it: on a hit, Fire damage equal to **3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier**. The blade sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
В свободном пространстве появляется Боль: A Large, intangible elemental spirit appears in an unoccupied space; its element determines the damage type: air — Lightning, water — Cold, earth — Thunder, fire — Fire. When a creature you can see enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it, and the spirit isn't holding anyone, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw: on a failed save, **8d8** damage and **Restrained** until the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained creature repeats the save: on a failure, it takes **4d8** damage; on a success, it breaks free.
В свой ход ваша досягаемость рукопашным: On your turn, your reach with a melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property increases by 10 feet. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to the weapon's own mastery property.
В свой ход вы можете бонусным действием: On your turn, you can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.
В свой ход вы совершаете одно дополнител: On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action. Once per Short or Long Rest; starting at level 17, twice, but only once on the same turn.
В свой ход, находясь в 5 фт. от согласно: When you're within 5 ft. of a willing creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, spending at least 5 ft. of movement; this movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Roll the die: until the start of your next turn, you or that creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the roll.
В точке в пределах дистанции зависает св: A glowing bead hovers at a point within range. When the spell ends, it explodes: each creature in a **20-foot-radius Sphere** makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking the accumulated Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The base damage is **12d6**, and it increases by **1d6** at the end of each of your turns. A creature that touches the bead makes a Dexterity saving throw: on a failed save, the bead explodes at once; on a success, the creature can throw it up to 40 feet, and it explodes when it strikes a creature or a solid object. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
В точке в пределах дистанции лопается ки: An acidic bubble bursts at a point within range: each creature in a **5-foot-radius Sphere** makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failed save.
В точке в пределах дистанции появляется: A spectral sword appears at a point within range and immediately makes a **melee spell attack** against a target within 5 feet of it: on a hit, **4d12 + modifier** Force damage. On later turns, as a **Bonus Action**, you can move the sword up to 30 feet to a spot you can see and attack again — the same target or a different one.

Ваше тело впадает в кататонию, а душа пе: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container (the Material component). From the container you perceive your surroundings, but you can't move or take Reactions; the only action you can take is to project your soul up to **100 feet**: back into your body (the spell ends) or into a **Humanoid** you can see. Creatures of your choice within range make a Wisdom saving throw; any creature fighting you or your companions succeeds automatically. On a failed save, until the spell ends, the creature has a **−10** penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and to its Passive Perception.
Выбранные существа в эманации 30 футов с: Chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Constitution saving throw: on a failed save, **5d6** Thunder damage and **5d6** Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice), and they have the Prone condition; on a success, half as much damage.

Burns for 1 hour on one flask of oil.

Давая бонусным действием кость Бардовско:

**Guided Summoning.** As a Bonus Action, you expend a use of Bardic Inspiration and choose the spirit yourself — one whose number is no higher than the maximum of your Bardic Inspiration die (d8 → up to the Shadow).

1. **Beloved** — the target regains Hit Points equal to the die + Cha. mod.

A ranged spell attack against a creature or an object. On a hit — 1d10 Fire damage; a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried starts burning.

Действием «Магия» вы выпускаете одного п: As a Magic action, you release one summoned spirit at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you: that spirit's effect from the Tales from Beyond table applies to it. The saving throw DC is your Bard spell save DC.

Once per Short or Long Rest; you can regain the use by expending a use of Second Wind.

Действием «Магия» вы призываете неуязвим: As a Magic action, you summon invulnerable spirits of order in a 30-foot Cube originating from you. Once per Long Rest; you can restore the use by expending a Psionic Energy Die.

До **двенадцати** видимых существ, котор: Up to **twelve** creatures you can see that can hear and understand you receive a suggestion — an achievable course of activity of 25 words or fewer that doesn't obviously lead to harm to them or their allies. До **десяти** согласных видимых существ: Up to **ten** willing creatures you can see can breathe underwater while keeping their normal breathing.

До **шести** видимых существ восстанавли: Up to **six** creatures you can see each regain Hit Points equal to **2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier**.

До трёх видимых существ совершают спасбр: Up to three creatures you can see make Charisma saving throws. Those that fail subtract **1d4** from their attack rolls and saving throws until the spell ends.
До трёх согласных существ (включая вас): Up to three willing creatures (including you) within 10 feet for each spell slot level above 7.
До трёх существ в пределах дистанции. По: Up to three creatures within range. Until the spell ends, each target adds **1d4** to its attack rolls and saving throws.
До трёх существ: максимум и текущие хиты: Up to three creatures: each one's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by **5** for the duration.

Используя Шквал ударов, вы можете замени: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace two Unarmed Strikes with a casting of a level 1 or level 2 Sorcerer spell that has a casting time of an action — as part of the same Bonus Action.

When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending Focus Points, and when a strike of the Flurry deals damage you can apply Hand of Harm to it without expending a Focus Point (still only once per turn). You have a number of these free uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) per Long Rest.
Исследователь жизни, смерти и нежизни: н: A student of life, death, and unlife: an undead familiar, raised servants, and mastery over their powers.
Исследователь прошлого, настоящего и буд: A seeker of the past, present, and future: foreseen rolls overwrite fate.
Источник вашей врождённой магии определя: The source of your innate magic determines your subclass features.
Исчадие, Небожитель, Фея или Элементаль,: A Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend that stays within range for the entire casting (typically inside an inverted Magic Circle) makes a Charisma saving throw at the end of the casting; on a failed save, it must serve you for the duration. If the creature was summoned by another spell, that spell's duration is extended to match this one. A bound creature does its best to follow your instructions, but a hostile one will twist your words. When it completes a task, it returns to you to report if you are on the same plane; otherwise, it waits where it was bound.
Исчадия, небожители, нежить, феи и элеме: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early with a Magic action: **Dismissal** — send such a creature within 5 feet back to its home plane (Charisma saving throw), or **Break Enchantment** — end the Charmed or Frightened condition or possession caused by such creatures on a creature you touch.
К одному броску урона любого вашего закл: You add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard spell of the Evocation school you cast.
К проверкам Харизмы вы добавляете модифи: Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to it equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). You also gain proficiency in one of these skills: Performance, Deception, or Persuasion.
К проверкам характеристик с навыком, кот: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.
К спасброскам Телосложения вы добавляете: You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1) to your Constitution saving throws. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll while you are in your Wild Rage and Bloodied, you regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier.
К урону выбранного заговора колдуна, нан: You add your Charisma modifier to the damage rolls of the chosen Warlock cantrip that deals damage.{0}
К урону заговоров друида прибавляется мо: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Druid cantrips; starting at level 15, their range increases by 300 feet.
К урону заговоров жреца прибавляется мод: Your Wisdom modifier is added to the damage of your Cleric cantrips; from level 14, such damage also grants Temporary Hit Points.
К урону, который вы наносите заговорами: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip.
К эффектам Жестокого удара добавляются:\:
The following are added to your Brutal Strike effects:

- **Staggering Blow.** The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw and can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
- **Sundering Blow.** The next attack roll made by another creature against the target before the start of your next turn gains a +5 bonus (no more than one such bonus per roll).
Каждое видящее узор существо в **кубе 30: Each creature in a **30-foot Cube** that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom saving throw or has the **Charmed** condition: while charmed, it has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0. The effect ends for a creature if it takes damage or someone takes an action to shake it out of its stupor.
Каждое существо в **60-футовом конусе**: Each creature in a **60-foot Cone** originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw: **8d8** Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue.
Каждое существо в **конусе 15 футов** со: Each creature in a **15-foot Cone** makes a Constitution saving throw or has the **Blinded** condition until the end of your next turn.
Каждое существо в **конусе 60 футов** со: Each creature in a **60-foot Cone** makes a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d8 for each to determine the ray's color. **1–5**: **12d6** damage on a failed save (1 — Fire, 2 — Acid, 3 — Lightning, 4 — Poison, 5 — Cold), half as much on a success. **6 Indigo**: on a failed save, Restrained; it makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns — three successes end the condition, three failures make it Petrified until freed by Greater Restoration. **7 Violet**: on a failed save, Blinded; it makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn — a success ends the blindness, a failure ends it and transports the target to another plane. **8**: two rays; roll twice more, rerolling any 8.
Каждое существо в **сфере радиусом 20 фу: Each creature in a **20-foot-radius Sphere** makes an Intelligence saving throw: **8d6** Psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. For 1 minute, a creature that failed subtracts **1d6** from its attack rolls, ability checks, and Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration; at the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Intelligence save, ending the effect on a success.
Каждое существо в **эманации 10 футов**: Each creature in a **10-foot Emanation** originating from you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save — 2d6 Necrotic damage, and it can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn; on a successful save — half as much damage.
Каждое существо в **эманации 5 футов** в: Each creature in a **5-foot Emanation** originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 Thunder damage on a failed save. The thunderous sound can be heard up to 100 feet away.
Каждый Гуманоид в **сфере радиусом 20 фу: Each Humanoid in a **20-foot-radius Sphere** makes a Charisma saving throw. For each one that fails, you choose: either it has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions (those already affecting it are suppressed for the duration), or it becomes **Indifferent** toward creatures of your choice it was hostile toward — until it or its allies take damage; when the spell ends, its attitude returns.
Каждый раз, когда вы бонусным действием: Whenever you take the Bonus Action to create or move the illusion of Invoke Duplicity, you can teleport, swapping places with it.
Каждый, кто нацеливает на защищённое сущ: Any creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failed save, it must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This doesn't protect against area effects. The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
Каменный предмет Среднего размера или ме: A Medium or smaller stone object or a section of stone up to 5 feet takes any shape: a weapon, a statue, a passage through a wall less than 5 feet thick, a sealed door. Two hinges and a latch are possible, but no finer mechanical detail.
Карающий меч против великого зла: неотст: An avenging sword against great evil: a relentless hunter who never lets their quarry go.
Касаясь магического предмета, вы узнаёте: Touching a magic item, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires Attunement, how many charges it has, and which spells are affecting it; for an item created by a spell, the name of that spell. Touching a creature, you learn which spells are currently affecting it.
Квадрат 10×10 футов покрывается скользко: A 10-foot square is covered in slick grease and becomes Difficult Terrain. Creatures in the area when the grease appears, and any that enter it or end their turn there, make a Dexterity saving throw or have the **Prone** condition.
Квадрат 20×20 футов зарастает цепкими ра: Grasping plants sprout in a 20-foot square, turning it into Difficult Terrain. Each creature in the area other than you must succeed on a Strength saving throw when the spell is cast or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends; as an action, it can free itself with a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.
Кислотный взрыв **сферой радиусом 20 фут: An acid explosion fills a **20-foot-radius Sphere**: Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, 10d4 Acid damage and another 5d4 at the end of the creature's next turn; on a success, half the initial damage.
Книга в кожаном переплёте на 100 чистых: A leather-bound book with 100 blank pages for recording Wizard spells.
Когда атака попадает по вам или по Окров: When an attack hits you or a Bloodied creature you can see within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to halve its damage (round down); a Critical Hit also loses all its special effects. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.
Когда благодаря Неукротимому вы преуспев: When you succeed on a saving throw thanks to Indomitable, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you.
Когда ваши хиты опускаются до 0, но вы н: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, choose creatures in a 30-foot Emanation: they make a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to 2d10 plus your Charisma modifier on a failed save (half as much on a successful one). Your Hit Points then become equal to twice your Warlock level, and you gain 1 Exhaustion level. Once per Short or Long Rest.

When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once per Long Rest. In addition, you can't be aged magically, and you cease visibly aging.
Когда видимое вами существо атакует друг: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to interpose your Shield if you're holding one. You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.
Когда видимое вами существо в пределах 6: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a damage roll, succeeds on an ability check, or hits with an attack, you can take a Reaction to expend a use of Bardic Inspiration: roll your Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll.
Когда видимое вами существо попадает ата: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage dealt to the target by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus. You must be holding a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon to use this Reaction.
Когда видимое вами существо промахиваетс: When a creature you can see misses you with an attack, you can take a Reaction to move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and then, as part of the same Reaction, make a ranged attack against it if it is within your weapon's range.
Когда видимое существо в пределах 30 фут: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can take a Reaction to force it to make a Wisdom saving throw: on a failed save, the attack misses and, if another creature is within the attack's range, it targets that creature instead (you choose which) using the same roll. Once per Long Rest; casting an Enchantment spell with a spell slot restores the use.
Когда видимое существо оказывается в эма: When a creature you can see enters the 10-foot Emanation around you or ends its turn there, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw (no more than once per turn): on a failed save, **4d6** Psychic damage, the Prone condition, and a push up to 10 feet away from you; on a success, half as much damage.
Когда видимый вами атакующий попадает по: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (round down).
Когда видимый вами враг в пределах 30 фу: When an enemy you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage and is then Bloodied (but not killed outright), you can take a Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of it, then make one melee attack. Uses — your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.
Когда видимый вами враг заканчивает ход: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed; then one ally within 30 feet of you can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Когда враг умирает в пределах 60 футов о: When an enemy dies within 60 feet of you, you or another creature within 60 feet of you regains Hit Points equal to twice your Cleric level. This doesn't work while you have the Incapacitated condition. Once per Short or Long Rest; you can restore the use by expending a level 6+ spell slot (no action required).
Когда вы бонусным действием даёте кость: When you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die as a Bonus Action, you can also become Invisible and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see as part of the same action. The invisibility lasts until the start of your next turn and ends early as soon as you cast a spell, deal damage, or make an attack roll.
Когда вы бонусным действием командуете п: When you take a Bonus Action to command your Primal Companion, it can also take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action as a Bonus Action. Its attacks can deal your choice of their normal damage type or Force damage.
Когда вы или союзник в пределах 60 футов: When you or an ally within 60 feet of you is about to make a Death Saving Throw, you can save them with a burst of radiance: they regain half their Hit Point maximum and can stand up. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of them take Radiant damage equal to 2d8 plus your Charisma modifier and have the Blinded condition until the end of the current turn. Once per Long Rest.
Когда вы или существо в пределах 30 футо: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled with Advantage.

When you or a creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to give that roll a +10 bonus, potentially turning the miss into a hit. Doing this for another creature's roll takes your Reaction.
Когда вы используете Ошеломляющий удар,: When you use Stunning Strike, its target has Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn — whether or not it succeeded on the save against the strike.
Когда вы наносите урон Коварной атакой п:
When you deal Sneak Attack damage with your Psychic Blade, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failed save, it has the Stunned condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

Once per Long Rest; you can restore the use by expending three Psionic Energy Dice.
Когда вы наносите урон существу заговоро: When you deal damage to a creature with a Cleric cantrip, you can give yourself or another creature within 60 feet of you Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.
Когда вы опускаете хиты врага до 0 — или: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points — or someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points — you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1).
Когда вы попадаете Коварной атакой в пер: When you hit with your Sneak Attack on the first round of a combat, the target must make a Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, the attack's damage is doubled.
Когда вы применяете Отравление Хитрого у: When you use the Poison option of your Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw against that effect. This damage ignores Resistance to Poison damage.
Когда вы творите «Божественную кару», вы: Whenever you cast *Divine Smite*, you and your allies in your Aura of Protection have Half Cover until the start of your next turn.
Когда вы творите с ячейкой заклинание, в: Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores Hit Points, you or another creature within 30 feet of you regains 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Hit Points (2d8 starting at level 10).
Когда другое существо наносит вам урон р: When another creature damages you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on the die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
Когда заклинание или Проведение божестве: When a spell or Channel Divinity restores Hit Points with dice, you don't roll them; instead, you use the highest number possible for each die (2d6 → 12).
Когда заклинание, сотворённое с ячейкой,: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell equal to 2 + the spell slot's level.
Когда по вам попадает атака с дробящим,: When an attack roll hits you and its damage includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (any damage starting at level 13), you can take a Reaction to reduce the attack's total damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Monk level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect the attack: a creature within 5 feet of you (for a melee attack) or within 60 feet of you (for a ranged attack, not behind Total Cover) makes a Dexterity saving throw and, on a failed save, takes damage of the same type equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die + your Dexterity modifier.
Когда по вам попадает атака, вы можете р: When you are hit by an attack, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (round down) and force the attacker to make a Dexterity saving throw (against your spell save DC): on a failed save, it takes 2d10 + your Charisma modifier damage (a type of your choice: {0}); on a successful one, half as much damage. Uses: a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.
Когда союзник, которого вы видите в пред: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Indomitable: the ally rerolls the save with a bonus equal to your Fighter level and must use the new roll.
Когда существо в пределах 60 фт. наносит: When you take damage from a creature within 60 ft. of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.
Когда существо под вашей Клятвой вражды: When a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against it if it is within your reach.
Когда существо попадает по вам броском а: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to force it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it has the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn, and while it is Stunned, its Speed is 0. Uses — your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.
Когда существо промахивается по вам руко: When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against that creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage.
Когда существо совершает бросок атаки по: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that roll. Whether the attack hits or misses, you can then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you.
Когда хиты Спутника-предтечи опускаются: When your Vestige Companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction and expend a Pact Magic spell slot: instead, its Hit Points return to their maximum, and it teleports to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. Once per Long Rest.
Когда хиты видимой вами нежити опускаютс: When an Undead you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can make it explode: roll a number of d6s equal to half its unspent Hit Dice (round up, minimum of 1d6). Creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Dexterity saving throw: on a failed save, they take Necrotic damage equal to the roll and can't take Reactions until the start of their next turn; on a successful save, they take half as much damage. For an Undead not under your control, this requires a Reaction and a level 5+ spell slot.
Когда хиты опускаются до 0, но вы не уми: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once per Long Rest.
Когда хиты цели впервые должны упасть до: The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points, it instead drops to **1**, and the spell ends. If the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated, and the spell ends.
Когда число ваших подготовленных заклина: Whenever your number of prepared spells increases as you gain levels, you can choose the new spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists; they count as Bard spells for you. When you replace a spell, you can also choose the replacement from those lists.
Кожа согласного существа грубеет, как ду: A willing creature's skin becomes as tough as bark: while the spell lasts, its AC can't be **lower than 17**.
Колонна пламени — цилиндр радиусом 10 и: A column of flame — a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw: **5d6** Fire damage and **5d6** Radiant damage, or half as much on a success.
Колющий и рубящий урон растут на 1к8 за: The Piercing and Slashing damage each increase by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 6.
Концентрация длится до 10 минут с ячейко: Your Concentration can last up to 10 minutes with a level 5 spell slot, up to 1 hour with a level 6 slot, and up to 8 hours with a level 7+ slot.
Концентрация длится до 4 часов с ячейкой: Your Concentration can last up to 4 hours with a level 2 spell slot, up to 8 hours with a level 3–4 slot, and up to 24 hours with a level 5+ slot.
Концентрация до 10 минут (ячейка 6-го ур: Concentration up to 10 minutes (level 6 slot), up to 1 hour (level 7), up to 8 hours (level 8–9).
Короткий отдых: потратьте кости, чтобы в: Short Rest: spend dice to regain HP (the roll + your Constitution modifier). A Long Rest gives them all back.
Коснитесь согласного существа и выберите: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds **1d4** to any ability check using that skill.
You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type (other than Psychic or Force). Until the spell ends, damage of that type dealt to the creature is reduced by **1d4**, no more than once per turn.
Кости или труп Среднего либо Маленького: The bones or corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid become a **Skeleton** or a **Zombie**. As a **Bonus Action**, you mentally command all your creations within 60 feet; without commands, they take the Dodge action. Control lasts 24 hours; casting the spell again before it expires reasserts control over four creatures you've already animated instead of raising a new one.
Кости к12 для самоисцеления бонусным дей: d12s for healing yourself as a Bonus Action.
Кость боевых искусств: к6, к8 с 5-го уро: Martial Arts die: d6, d8 at level 5, d10 at level 11, d12 at level 17.
Кость вдохновения: к6, с 5-го уровня к8,: Bardic Inspiration die: d6, d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, d12 at level 15.
Кость превосходства: к8, с 10-го уровня: Superiority Die: d8, d10 at level 10, d12 at level 18.
Кость пси-энергии: к6, с 5-го уровня к8,: Psionic Energy Die: d6; d8 from level 5, d10 from level 11, d12 from level 17. A Short Rest restores one die.
Кость псионической энергии: к6, с 5-го у: Psionic Energy Die: d6, d8 at level 5, d10 at level 11, d12 at level 17. A Short Rest restores one die.
Кость урона вашей «Метки охотника» стано: The damage die of your Hunter's Mark is a d10 rather than a d6.
Кость урона: 1к10 на 5-м, 1к12 на 11-м и: Damage die: 1d10 at character level 5, 1d12 at level 11, and 2d6 at level 17.
Кость чародейного выстрела: к6, к8 с 10-: Arcane Shot die: d6, d8 at level 10, d10 at level 15, d12 at level 18.
Крепкий народ гор и подземных твердынь,: A hardy people of mountains and underground strongholds, forged—so the legends say—by the gods from stone and metal. Stubborn and enduring, they can feel the stone beneath their feet.
Кристалл, сфера, жезл, посох или палочка: A crystal, orb, rod, staff, or wand; a Spellcasting Focus for Sorcerer, Warlock, and Wizard spells.
Критическое попадание происходит при рез: You score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.
Кровавое бешенство: преимущество на атак: Blood Frenzy: advantage on attacks against wounded creatures. Breathes only underwater. Blindsight 60 feet.
Куб 20 футов паутины — труднопроходимая: A 20-foot Cube of webs — Difficult Terrain and a Lightly Obscured area (without anchor points, the webs collapse at the start of your next turn). A creature that starts its turn in the webs or enters them for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity saving throw or has the **Restrained** condition; it can break free with an action and a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. A burning 5-foot Cube of webs burns away in one round, dealing 2d4 Fire damage to creatures that start their turn in it.
Куб 5 футов вращающихся кинжалов: сущест: A 5-foot Cube of spinning daggers: a creature in it when it appears, when it enters it, at the end of its turn, or when the Cube moves into its space takes **4d4 Slashing damage** (no more than once per turn). As a Magic action on later turns, you teleport the Cube up to 30 feet.
Куб со стороной от 5 до 100 футов защищё: A Cube from 5 to 100 feet on each side is protected by the properties you choose: sound can't pass the boundary; the boundary is dark and opaque to sight; Divination sensors can't enter; creatures inside can't be targeted by Divination spells; teleportation and planar travel into and out of it are impossible. If you cast it on the same spot every day for 365 days, the effect becomes permanent.
Ледяной шар взрывается в выбранной точке: A frigid globe bursts at a point you choose: each creature in a **60-foot-radius Sphere** makes a Constitution saving throw, taking **10d6** Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If it strikes water, the globe freezes it 6 inches deep over a 30-foot square for 1 minute; creatures that were swimming there are **Restrained** and can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to break free. You can refrain from firing the globe: it becomes a sling-stone-sized pellet that you or a creature you give it to can throw (40 feet) or hurl with a sling; it shatters on impact or on its own after 1 minute, and it can also be defused.
Лечение и урон +1к12 за каждый уровень я: The healing and the damage increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.
